# Day AI | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Word location | "Customs memory layer" for AI agents, automatically collecting the context of mail, meetings and collaboration, which can coexist with existing CRMs. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Not complete ERP or localised trading system; two-way fields with existing CRM, historical backfill scope and proxy write permissions need to be validated by POC. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Not a full ERP or localized trading system; bi-directional fields with existing CRM, historical backfill scope, and proxy write permissions require POC validation. |
